observations: Three photos show a black rectangular console wrapped in clear plastic, placed on a bright green surface.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' logos visible on the front edge in photo 0, 1, and 2.
A camouflage-patterned controller is placed in front of the console in all photos.
A coiled black cable (likely power or HDMI) is visible to the right of the console.
A small USB cable is taped to the top of the console in a clear plastic sleeve.
The console appears to be a PlayStation 4 Slim model based on its size and shape.
No disc drive is visible, consistent with the PS4 Slim design.
The console is still wrapped in plastic, suggesting it may be new or well-preserved.
Watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The console is wrapped in plastic, so cleanliness of the surface cannot be confirmed. The 500GB capacity is not visible in any photo; no label or screen shows storage size.
No visual evidence of hacking (e.g., custom firmware, modded UI, or jailbreak indicators). The console is wrapped and not powered on. Hacking status cannot be verified remotely.
No games or game discs are visible in any photo. No screen shows installed games. The presence and number of games cannot be confirmed remotely.
